Does Not Die of Old Age
Sidekick - a temporary ally in an optional room
Off shoot - option passage to an optional area basiacally a second dungeon
Forshadowing - hint at future danger no details
Oddity - a unique room related to the setting that explains why the dungeon exists or is abandoned that is fixed in the dungeon
Forge - a place to create unqiue item that will make the players want to return to use
Faction homebase - factions in the dungeon conflict
Map or Directions - hint at  locations in and outside the dungeon
Puzzle - link to other locations with keys in differnt rooms and combine with other room type
